1.title: What to Watch in Washington State’s Primaries as Gluesenkamp Perez Faces a Challenge
1.summary: Representative Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, a moderate Democrat, is going head-to-head with candidates to her right and her left in a battleground district.

2.title: Michigan to decide bitter Senate Democratic primary in test for divided party
2.summary: Moderate congresswoman Haley Stevens faces a stiff challenge from left-wing outsider Abdul El-Sayed.

3.title: Todd Blanche Clears Committee Vote, Paving Way for Attorney General Confirmation
3.summary: Todd Blanche’s nomination now advances to the Senate floor, where he is expected to be confirmed, even though several Republicans have not yet committed to supporting him.

4.title: Oil prices fall on hopes Strait of Hormuz could reopen
4.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent both announced talks had progressed to allow shipments to resume.

5.title: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack
5.summary: Ukraine said the video - showing a terrified civilian being hounded by a remotely-controlled drone - amounted to a war crime.

6.title: More than 170 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
6.summary: The government says all of the migrants, who were attempting to cross to the UK, will be returned to France.
